gloss: redeeming quality; merit; forte; strong point

definitions.explanation: A positive characteristic or skill that makes someone or something valuable.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{取|と}り{柄|え}は{健康|けんこう}なことだ。
examples.english: My only redeeming quality is that I'm healthy.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{安|やす}いのが{取|と}り{柄|え}だ。
examples.english: This shop's strong point is that it's cheap.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{柄|え}がないと{思|おも}っていたが、{努力家|どりょくか}だと{言|い}われた。
examples.english: I thought I had no strong points, but I was told I'm hardworking.

notes:
FORMATION:
{取|と}る (to take) + {柄|え} (handle, merit)

USAGE:
Often used in modest or self-deprecating contexts:
・{取|と}り{柄|え}がない (to have no redeeming qualities)
・{唯一|ゆいいつ}の{取|と}り{柄|え} (only strong point)

COMMON PATTERN:
「〜が{取|と}り{柄|え}」 (X is one's/its strong point)
・{元気|げんき}なのが{取|と}り{柄|え} (being energetic is my forte)
・{安|やす}さが{取|と}り{柄|え} (cheapness is its selling point)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{長所|ちょうしょ} - strength, merit (more formal)
・{得意|とくい} - specialty, strong suit
